purpose: Machine-readable PowerSweep contract. Live Desk owns canonical macro/market state and immutable Market Motion. PowerSweep consumes that state, keeps its legacy Market Motion discovery only as an internal AUDIT_ONLY comparator, then spends a bounded research budget on portfolio translation, company evidence, divergences, hidden concentration and capital-allocation decisions.

cranium.name: Market Research Cranium
cranium.role: Research seed, synthesis layer and source-URL registry. It is not direct canonical evidence or a scoring input until material claims are independently verified.
cranium.ingestRule: Read the current Cranium tab before the daily macro sweep. Extract claims, source URLs, PDFs/images and disagreements. Verify material factual claims independently. Preserve sell-side opinions as attributed views rather than converting them into facts.

requiredSweepOrder: Read current Cranium tab and extract new claims, source URLs, charts/PDF leads and explicit disagreements. Treat it as research seed/context, not canonical macro state.
Load data/live-desk-canonical.json, data/portfolio-live-overlay.json and data/holding-tape.json first. Validate contract versions, as-of times, source health, contradictions and unresolved gaps.
Use Live's canonical monetary/market state as the macro baseline. Do not perform a parallel broad macro sweep unless Live is stale/unavailable; record that condition as a blocking gap instead.

Consume immutable promoted Live Market Motion from data/live-desk-canonical.json first and map exact ticker links into portfolio research priority. Generate data/motion-shadow.json from the legacy Power Stack discovery feed to measure overlap and uncovered portfolio-specific residuals, but do not let shadow-only discovery enter the active research queue.
Triage current holdings using macro exposure, completed-session tape, action gates and hidden concentration. Promote only decision-relevant divergences/data gaps into the holding research budget.
Research at most the configured holdingDeepDives. Keep fundamental scores unchanged unless new company-level evidence warrants a revision.
Review the watchlist using price/action state, portfolio overlap/diversification and company-specific catalysts. Research at most the configured watchlistDeepDives.
Review developing themes only where deeper work could change a holding/watchlist/capital-allocation decision. Respect the configured themeDeepDives cap.
Run the China focus adjunct only for active documented China/HK exposures or tracked ideas, capped by chinaAdjunctNames.
Emit explicit CHANGE / NO_CHANGE / RESEARCH_GAP decisions and the evidence required for each unresolved item.
Regenerate Power Stack-owned snapshots only when their underlying inputs changed. Never export a Live-derived macro adjustment back to Live.

usRateSweep.ownership: Live Desk owns the US monetary/rates regime. Power Stack consumes the canonical state and maps it to portfolio exposures rather than recomputing a competing regime.
requiredFields: 2s10s curve and other material curve shape
SOFR / TGCR / BGCR / EFFR funding conditions and volumes when available
source freshness, contradictions and unresolved gaps
usRateSweep.interpretationRule: Do not collapse these fields into a second Power Stack macro score. Use the Live state to test each holding's assumptions, funding/valuation sensitivity and shared portfolio exposures.

requiredFields: credit transmission into private-sector capex and consumption
chinaRateSweep.interpretationRule: Low Chinese yields are not automatically a bullish easing signal. Separate low discount rates from weak domestic demand, low bank margins, trapped domestic savings and poor credit transmission. Treat fiscal/recapitalisation support separately from a PBOC rate cut.

regionalSensitivityRule: For each holding/watchlist name, record US monetary sensitivity and China-rate/demand sensitivity separately. Use low/moderate/high/very-high plus the causal mechanism and whether Live evidence is confirming, contradicting or unresolved; do not infer a buy/sell action from sensitivity alone.
sourceHierarchy: Primary filings and company investor relations
Reuters/FT/Bloomberg or equivalent high-quality market reporting
Specialist research and attributed sell-side commentary
Cranium/creator/social sources as research leads and synthesis only until corroborated

ownership.liveDesk: Canonical macro/market acquisition, monetary signals, source health, cross-asset confirmation, contradictions and market-level divergence reasoning.
ownership.powerSweep: Portfolio translation, company-specific verification, holding/watchlist research, hidden concentration, action-gate maintenance, opportunity ranking and capital-allocation questions.
ownership.forbiddenFeedback: No Live-derived macro score, overlay score or PowerSweep confirmation may be exported back to Live as independent evidence.

runOrder: INTAKE: validate data/live-desk-canonical.json, data/portfolio-live-overlay.json and data/holding-tape.json before any external research.
TRIAGE: rank portfolio divergences, unresolved holding data, high-review holdings and hidden concentration. Decide what actually merits research.

MOTION: consume promoted Live Market Motion as the only active short-horizon Motion source and use exact ticker links only to raise bounded holding/watchlist research priority. There is no local Motion fallback. Any additional company-specific research must use the existing holding/watchlist/theme budgets and is stored as Power Stack research, not as active Market Motion.
HOLDINGS: research only the capped set of holdings where new evidence could change an action gate, thesis risk, sizing read or fundamental score.
WATCHLIST: research the capped set of candidates where price asymmetry, diversification benefit or a fresh company catalyst could change priority.
THEMES: investigate only themes that materially affect current holdings/candidates or create a genuinely differentiated new opportunity.
CHINA ADJUNCT: run the separate China/HK transmission check only for documented exposures or active tracked ideas.
DECISION: emit explicit CHANGE / NO_CHANGE / RESEARCH_GAP outcomes for holdings, watchlist, themes and portfolio rules.
PUBLISH: update Power Stack-owned outputs only. Never rebuild Live macro state inside PowerSweep.
priorityRules: A holding with directional macro overlay + opposite completed-session tape is PRIORITY_1 divergence research.
A holding with missing instrument/company data that blocks sizing or concentration measurement is PRIORITY_1 data-gap research.
A holding with MIXED overlay is not automatically researched; promote it only when the tape move is material, an action gate is near, or company evidence changed.
A holding whose tape CONFIRMS the macro overlay is normally monitoring-only unless a company catalyst or action gate needs verification.
Watchlist research should prefer high-quality names near actionable zones and names that diversify current hidden concentration.
Live Stock Radar is discovery/research-priority input only. It cannot mechanically rerank Power Stack candidates.
Do not research a theme merely because it is top-ranked if Live already supplies the relevant macro mechanism and no portfolio decision depends on deeper work.
UNKNOWN / UNRESOLVED is a valid outcome. Do not spend remaining budget to manufacture certainty.
Routine Market Motion discovery is Live-owned. Power Stack must not create a parallel active Motion feed or substitute local discovery when Live Motion is missing or stale.

Portfolio-specific external research remains allowed only inside the existing holding/watchlist/theme investigation budgets. Those findings are Power Stack research evidence, not a fallback Market Motion feed.
Political/geopolitical motion must remain factual and attributed; use it only for market-transmission analysis.

If a Market Motion item requires a company deep-dive to change an action gate or score, that verification must consume the existing holding/watchlist/theme research budget rather than creating an unlimited side channel.

Exact ticker-linked promoted Live Market Motion may raise a holding or watchlist name inside the existing research caps, but it cannot change company fundamentals, Base Conviction, ranking, sizing or an action gate without independent company-level evidence.

Do not spend external discovery budget recreating a hook already supplied by immutable promoted Live Market Motion; investigate only the unresolved company-specific implication or a genuinely new portfolio-relevant development.
requiredOutputs: run health and canonical input freshness
portfolio divergences ranked by decision relevance
holding research queue with why-now, required evidence and possible decision impact
watchlist research queue with overlap/diversification note
changes allowed to write back into Power Stack
changes forbidden from feeding back into Live
market motion feed with hook, big-picture bridge and next test

marketMotion.surface: internal audit only; not rendered on motion.html
marketMotion.role: Retired from active/UI consumption. Retained only as an AUDIT_ONLY comparator input against immutable Live Market Motion.
marketMotion.scoreRule: No Market Motion item changes Base Conviction or company fundamentals by itself.
marketMotion.liveUpstreamRule: Immutable promoted Live Market Motion is the only active short-horizon Motion source. The legacy Power Stack feed is internal audit only and may never substitute for missing or stale Live Motion.

monitoringPolicy.routinePrinciple: Keep the everyday monitor deliberately small. Do not make every available signal, ticker or headline a standing watch item.
monitoringPolicy.deepSweepRule: Use the broader Live fields, dealer/funding plumbing, wider stock universe and full theme list only during an explicit deeper sweep or when a core signal creates a new decision-relevant divergence.
monitoringPolicy.bondRule: Treat bonds as a first-class capital-allocation comparison: cash/short Treasury, intermediate duration, long duration and TIPS. The routine screen stays compact; 20Y/30Y, term premium, auctions/supply and UST-vs-JGB/Bund are deep-sweep items.
